title: Accurate and Auditable ECG Classification via Visibility Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41795v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physicians read electrocardiograms (ECGs) from waveform shape and timing, yet accurate deep-learning classifiers rarely show which waveform regions drive their predictions. We introduce LYNX-ECG, a graph neural network that represents each heartbeat as a sparse visibility graph of timestamped turning points. On CODE-Test, LYNX-ECG reaches a macro F1 score of 0.889, outperforming five baselines including the ECGFounder foundation model, while its graphs need about 14% of the storage of graphs built from every sample. Because each node maps to a specific ECG time, we can delete clinically defined waveform regions and alter beat timing to audit predictions. For conduction disorders, the clinically expected region was the strongest evidence in more than 90% of correct predictions. translated_title: 基于可视图神经网络的准确且可审计的心电图分类
translated_abstract: 医生通过波形形态和时序特征来阅读心电图（ECG），然而精确的深度学习分类器很少能显示是哪些波形区域驱动了其预测。我们提出了LYNX-ECG，这是一种将每个心跳表示为由带时间戳的转折点构成的稀疏可视图的图神经网络。在CODE-Test数据集上，LYNX-ECG达到了0.889的宏F1分数，优于包括ECGFounder基础模型在内的五个基线模型，同时其图所需的存储空间仅为基于每个采样点构建的图的约14%。由于每个节点都映射到特定的心电图时间点，我们可以通过删除临床定义的波形区域并改变心跳时序来审计模型的预测。对于传导障碍，在超过90%的正确预测中，临床预期的区域是最强的证据。心动过缓和心动过速的判断跟随心率变化而传导间期保持不变，而当心跳间变异被移除时，心房颤动的判断随之消失。
tldr: 提出LYNX-ECG，一种将心跳表示为带时间戳转折点稀疏可视图的图神经网络，在以约14%的存储成本实现超越基础模型的心电图分类精度的同时，能够通过删除或修改特定波形区域来审计模型预测的临床依据。
en_tdlr: LYNX-ECG, a graph neural network representing heartbeats as sparse visibility graphs of timestamped turning points, achieves ECG classification accuracy surpassing foundation models with ~14% storage cost, while enabling auditing of predictions by deleting or modifying specific waveform regions.
